svg.title: Autocomplete while you type
svg.desc: Production CalloutAutoComplete renders the real matching names, IDs and icons for > [!i over a CodeMirror editor, using installed Obsidian styles. Seven complete matching rows appear in their production order. Idea is selected. The remaining actual rows are cropped by the native scrollable suggestion list.
